response.overview: Traumatized cop Greenwood finds his world flipped upside down when he crosses paths with a carefree monkey. At first, Greenwood wants nothing to do with his new furry companion, but soon discovers that the monkey is connected to a shadowy organization plaguing Karma City and his own past. Reluctantly teaming up, Greenwood and the monkey take on the ruthless Iron Lung, the mastermind behind the chaos. As they battle villains and confront their own demons, they discover the true meaning of justice, friendship and teamwork. Together, they form the dynamic duo known as Banana Shotgun.
response.tagline: GET READY FOR A LOAD OF B.S
response.title: Banana Shotgun
